page.layout: One page of text. At the top, a tree diagram of labels in brackets, centred. Below it, running text in one column with four paragraphs. No marginal notes. Printed page number and running head at the top, signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Quotuplex est Genus? Disciplinae caussa triplex fingitur: Summum, quod Græci γενικόν[?], id est latissimum ac fusissimum nominant. medium quod (vt diximus) ὑπαλλάλον[?], & subalternum appellant: ac postremò infimum, quod idem εἰδικώτατον[?] vocant.

Quod est Summum Genus? Quo nullum neque antiquitate, neque amplitudine maius est, longissimeque omnium à sensibus abest. Itaque cùm species esse non possit, de omnibus sub se subiectis enuntiatur. veluti apud Philosophos Substantia: apud Iurisconsultos, Res quae in superioribus figuris supremum locum obtinent.

Quod est Medium? Quod inter superius atque inferius interiectù, huic genus, illi species est. veluti, Corpus. itaque cum Re collatum, species est: cum animatis, genus. Sic Pater inter auum & filium ita interiectus est, vt illi sit filius, huic pater.
Quod est infimum? Quod angustissimum est, neque ullum in se aliud complectitur. vt

page.notes: Greek words in the second paragraph are doubtful at the scan resolution: "γενικόν" (first), "ὑπαλλάλον" (second) and "εἰδικώτατον" (third) are marked [?]. The diagram labels were copied as printed. The printed signature "B 4" is at the foot right. The page ends mid-sentence with "vt", which is full text and not a catchword. Long s was written as a plain s throughout.
